ios.desc:
Swipe through new English words like scrolling your feed. Vokab makes vocabulary learning fast, fun, and addictive.

Whether you're studying for exams, improving your writing and speaking skills, or building a stronger everyday vocabulary, Vokab is the simplest way to learn and remember new words. Every word comes with real examples, definitions, and native audio pronunciation so you don't just memorize. You truly understand.

SWIPE TO LEARN
Discover words through a familiar card feed. Each vocabulary card includes a clear definition, a real-world example sentence, and native speaker audio. Swipe right when you know a word. Swipe left for details. No menus, no friction. Just practice.

HEAR EVERY WORD
Native audio pronunciation is built into every word. Synchronized character-by-character text highlighting follows along as you listen, helping you connect spelling with how English words actually sound. Perfect for improving your pronunciation and speaking confidence.

PRACTICE WITH QUIZZES
Test your knowledge with interactive vocabulary quizzes. Multiple choice questions, instant visual feedback, and streak tracking keep every practice session engaging. The more you learn, the smarter Vokab gets at surfacing the words you need.

10,000+ WORDS ACROSS 50+ CATEGORIES
From academic and business vocabulary to daily conversation and science, there's always something new to learn. Explore by category or let smart recommendations guide your practice.

YOUR PROGRESS, EVERYWHERE
Vokab syncs seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch via iCloud. Start a vocab session on your commute, continue at your desk, and review on your wrist. Pick up right where you left off.

LEARN OFFLINE
Download word lists and practice anywhere. On planes, in the subway, or wherever there's no internet connection.

WHY LEARNERS LOVE VOKAB
· Native speaker audio for every word
· Spaced repetition to build long-term memory
· Streak tracking to keep your daily practice habit
· Detailed progress analytics
· Beautiful, distraction-free design
· Works across all Apple devices
· Free to start, no account required

Expand your vocabulary. Improve your English. Build better writing and speaking skills. Download Vokab and start learning today.
